title: Winning the Lost in Kansas City
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message of prayer and petition, encouraging listeners to trust in God's provision and care for their daily needs. From finances to family vacations, Pastor Chris reminds us that God is concerned with every detail of our lives and invites us to come before Him with confidence and faith. This inspiring sermon will ignite your heart to pray with expectation and faith, and to trust that God is working everything out for His good.
